units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“你在这里，朱雀院还替你担心，

en.t: Genji said to her, "While you are here, Retired Emperor Suzaku is still worried about you,

units.source_text: 如今你说要往深山，真使我好伤心啊！”

en.t: and now you say you want to go deep into the mountains. It truly breaks my heart!"

units.source_text: 现在三公主对源氏正面也不看一眼。

en.t: Now the Third Princess would not even look Genji in the face.

units.source_text: 她的额发异常美丽，面庞十分可爱，竟像一个孩童。

en.t: Her hair at her forehead was extraordinarily beautiful, and her face was so lovely that she seemed just like a child.

units.source_text: 源氏看了不胜怜惜，想道：“为什么弄到这般模样呢？”

en.t: Seeing her, Genji was overcome with pity and thought, "How did she come to look like this?"

units.source_text: 深恐引起色念，蒙受佛罚，便努力自持。

en.t: Deeply afraid of stirring sensual thoughts and incurring Buddhist punishment, he struggled to restrain himself.

units.source_text: 两人隔着一层帷屏，但又不很疏远，适当地互相应对。

en.t: The two were separated by a single curtain screen, but they were not very distant, and they responded to each other with proper restraint.
